Fuzzes type decode and emits serialized and YAML output.

# Purpose
This file implements a fuzzing entry point for runtime type decoding and output generation. It reads an input buffer whose first byte selects a type from `fd_types_vt_list`, decodes the remaining bytes with the matching `decode_footprint` and `decode` functions, and then walks the decoded object to produce two text forms: a custom serialized byte stream and a YAML representation. The helper [`custom_serializer_walk`](<#custom_serializer_walk>) handles each `FD_FLAMENCO_TYPE_*` case and writes values to a `FILE` stream in a format that can be stored in the output buffer.

The public function [`fd_solfuzz_type_run`](<#fd_solfuzz_type_run>) builds the result object `fd_exec_test_type_effects_t` in scratch memory and returns it to the caller. On success, it copies the generated serialized data into `effects->representation` and the YAML text into `effects->yaml`; on failure, it sets `effects->result` to indicate an error. The code uses `fd_solfuzz_runner_t`, scratch allocation, `fd_flamenco_yaml`, and protobuf byte arrays to package the decoded type data for test and fuzz execution.
